fragments.text: Hello, everyone. Thanks for having me. My name is Igor Samahotsky and I create AI practical solutions for my work for external colleagues and so on. So today, my focus is to explain how AI actually transforms the accessibility of data to regular people and to professionals. For many years, I've been working on open data policy and the problem I and my colleagues face that even though there are many data states available from public sector and also from private sector, but the data is hard actually to use and to transform into daily actions. So I will show how we with AI transform this and you could basically replicate any of our products or approaches. Today, I will focus mostly on the
